title: Nano Banana 2
description: Google Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) — high-efficiency text-to-image and image editing with multi-reference composition from up to 9 reference images and 0.5K-4K output. Billing: 65 credits per image at 1K (default); 50 at 0.5K, 100 at 2K, 150 at 4K.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 9) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image.

size.description: Output resolution tier. 1K bills 65 credits per image; 0.5K bills 50, 2K bills 100, 4K bills 150.
